title: Band personnel in 1935-36: Floyd Smith, Rags Porter, Hudson, Chester Lane
summary: The brothers trade recollections about who played drums, guitar, trumpet, bass and piano from 1935 into 1936.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: On guitar we picked up a young man, named Floyd Smith. Floyd Smith. Floyd was a little young genius. On the guitar, could play in all keys. He could improvise -- he could play harmonics on the guitar, he was just -- just a genius. Floyd stayed with us until 1938. And, in the meantime, the band opened up in 1935, and they opened up with -- was that Ziggy Johnson?
That was '36, wasn't it?
In '36, was Ziggy?
Wait a minute, '34, S. H. Dudley, '35, -- '35 with Alexander. '36 with Ziggy and, (unintelligible) Alexander, we played New Year's Eve...
That's right Alexander, that's right.
And he did that thing on the bandstand, with one of the brother's wives, he got a little carried away.
Yeah.
And was '36 when Ziggy came here.
The band went through '35, with Joe Jones on the drums, and with Floyd Smith on the guitar.
That was '36, wasn't it Hayes?
Huh?
Sidney was with us -- opened with us in Spring of '35, Sidney was with us and we opened, and that Fall, he opened with us that Fall, and he stayed after --
Not after Christmas.
Yeah, almost to Christmas, yeah, almost to Christmas.
Uh-huh.
Then Joe Jones --
Joe Jones came in, uh-huh.
It was part of '35.
Well Floyd Smith had joined us, hadn't he?
Yeah, Floyd had joined us.
Floyd Smith had joined us. And in the brass section we still had Harry Edison.
Uh-huh. Harry was still with us.
And, --
When did we get Rags Porter?
Just shortly after we came back from Little Rock.
Uh-huh.
Heard Rags. We got Rags, in the meantime we used on piano, Delloyd McKay.
McKay.
On piano, and shortly after we brought Rags up, we had Rags, Crack, -- no, we had Rags, Harry and George Hudson.
Uh-huh.
And we had those three. And, on trombone, who was that on trombone?
Still had Smitty, still had Smitty.
We had Smitty, Smitty on the trombone.
Uh-huh.
On the bass fiddle, Page left us.
Page left and did we get Huck King for awhile after Page left? Vernon King?
No, we got this other boy, Jones --
Oh, yeah. Jimmy Jones.
Jimmy Jones.
Jimmy Jones, he's in New York.
We got Jimmy Jones. And then he went and joined Noble Sissle.
Noble Sissle.
On bass. Then we got Huck --
Uh-huh.
Huck King. And that took us through '35 into '36. Into '36, we sent down and got Chester Lane.
Uh-huh.
Chester Lane, we had heard him in Little Rock, Arkansas, and our home town and we brought Chester Lane up to the band.
What instrument did he play?
He played the piano. Chester Lane was a very fine piano player.
He went through GREAT LAKES too (unintelligible).
Oh?
Yeah.
He was Alan Floyd. with the band in Florida.
And they sent him to Florida, didn't they?
Uh-huh.
